opening.argument: The material is identified as a call-center conversation, with the title stating, "CITIBANK - (Call Center Conversation)." The caller describes a practical problem with ATM access, saying, "I cannot withdraw money on my ATM card," and asks, "Can you transfer me to Citibank America?" The response, "Call your bank," directs the caller toward ordinary banking assistance rather than presenting a promoted financial offer to viewers. The statement, "I have 13,000 in my bank account. Why can't I withdraw my money?" is part of that dispute, while the refusal to transfer money describes the caller's response, not a solicitation or completed transaction.
